label: Articles
outcome: Lo studente sceglie a/an, the o zero article in frasi e brevi testi distinguendo singolare numerabile non specifico, referente identificabile e categoria generale, senza trasferire automaticamente l'articolo italiano.
must_master: a/an with a non-specific singular countable noun
the for an already mentioned or situationally identifiable referent
zero article with general plural categories
zero article with common general uncountable nouns
first mention with a/an followed by known reference with the

scope_boundary.advanced_idioms: Do not systematically teach institutional zero-article idioms such as go to school/hospital/prison as a separate rule set.
scope_boundary.geography: Do not teach geographical article exceptions with countries, seas, mountain ranges or institutions.
scope_boundary.proper_names: Proper-name article patterns are outside this recovery slice.
scope_boundary.countability: Use countability only as a prerequisite for article choice; do not reteach the entire countable/uncountable topic.

italian_learner_risks.risk: overusing the for categories in general
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: The dogs are friendly. (= dogs in general)

italian_learner_risks.risk: omitting a/an before a singular countable noun
using the on first mention without an identifiable reference
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: I bought the notebook yesterday. (= no previous reference)

italian_learner_risks.risk: failing to switch to the after first mention
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: I saw a dog. A dog was wet.
italian_learner_risks.target: I saw a dog. The dog was wet.

italian_learner_risks.risk: choosing a/an from spelling rather than sound
using the before a general uncountable concept
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: I like the music. (= music in general)

context_bank: introducing an object then referring to it again

requirements: teach discourse reference, not a three-row memorisation table only
contrast first mention and known reference
contrast specific reference with general plural/uncountable zero article
increase autonomy from recognition to production
approximately 60 percent standard and 40 percent challenge

quality_rejections: a worksheet that reduces article choice to 'singular=a, plural=the'
systematic use of the before general categories
a/an questions based only on letters while ignoring sound
advanced geography or institutional article exceptions
ambiguous first-mention tasks where a specific shared referent could reasonably exist
titles that reveal 'use zero article' or 'use the'
difficulty created by rare nouns rather than reference decisions
